children: EU Ambassador to the United States Jovita Neliupšienė said Europe must keep supporting Ukraine while applying “maximum pressure” on Moscow because Russia has not changed its war aims, according to Bloomberg.
Her comments came as US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visited Moscow before heading to Kyiv in an effort to revive stalled peace negotiations.

title: GEOPOLITICS | EU Envoy Calls for Maximum Pressure on Russia
